declarations.description:
A text input with a popup list of options: filtered from its own
`<option>` children, fetched from a URL, or produced by a function.
Form-associated, with the WAI-ARIA combobox keyboard pattern.
declarations.name: ComboBox

members.name: value
members.description:
The current value: the chosen option's value, or the typed text with
`allow-custom`. Setting it chooses the matching option (by value, then
by label). Script changes don't fire events.

members.name: text
members.description: The text in the input.

members.name: options
members.description: The options currently in the list.

members.name: selectedOption
members.description: The chosen option element, if it's in the list.

members.name: input
members.description: The inner `<input>` (generated, or the one you wrote as a child).

members.name: searchFunction
members.description:
A function that produces options for a query, instead of filtering the
child `<option>`s or fetching `src`: `async (query, { signal }) =>`
an HTML string, an array of strings / `{ value, label }` / Nodes, or a
Node. `signal` aborts when a newer search starts.

type.text: ((query: string, init: { signal: AbortSignal }) => unknown) | null

members.name: focus
members.description: Focus the input.

events.name: input
events.description: The user changed the value (chose an option, or typed with `allow-custom`).

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed a new value (chose an option, or left the field after typing with `allow-custom`).

events.name: toggle
events.description: The list opened or closed (a ToggleEvent with `oldState`/`newState`, like a popover).

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder for the input.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction and form submission. Also inherited from a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid until there's a value.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the option list is showing. Reflects.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial value (the value of an option, or text with `allow-custom`).

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL template for remote options; `{query}` is replaced with the encoded text. JSON or HTML responses.
Name submitted with the form.
attributes.name: name

attributes.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing before searching. Default 0 for local options, 200 for `src`/`searchFunction`.
attributes.name: debounce

attributes.description: Characters needed before searching. Default 0.
attributes.name: min-length

attributes.description: Typed text is a valid value even if it matches no option.
attributes.name: allow-custom

declarations.summary: An accessible autocomplete/search input with a popup option list.

declarations.name: MutableNodeList
declarations.default: class extends NodeList { item(i = 0) { return this[i]; } push(...nodes) { assertNodes(nodes); return Array.prototype.push.apply(this, nodes); } pop() { return Array.prototype.pop.call(this); } shift() { return Array.prototype.shift.call(this); } unshift(...nodes) { assertNodes(nodes); return Array.prototype.unshift.apply(this, nodes); } // Browsers' NodeList.prototype iteration methods *are* Array.prototype's // (per WebIDL), so they already work here; DOM implementations like // happy-dom read internal state instead. Pin the spec behavior. [Symbol.iterator]() { return Array.prototype.values.call(this); } values() { return Array.prototype.values.call(this); } keys() { return Array.prototype.keys.call(this); } entries() { return Array.prototype.entries.call(this); } forEach(callback, thisArg) { return Array.prototype.forEach.call(this, callback, thisArg); } }

declarations.description:
Cycles a class through a fixed list on target elements, persisted to
localStorage, driven by buttons inside it or invoker commands.
declarations.name: ClassCycler

members.name: values
members.description: The values to cycle through, in order.

members.name: value
members.description: The current value. Setting it applies and persists it, without an event.

members.name: targets
members.description: The elements whose class is set.

members.name: next
members.description: Move to the next value (wrapping), without an event.

members.name: previous
members.description: Move to the previous value (wrapping), without an event.

events.name: change
events.description: The user changed the value with a button or command.

attributes.name: classes
attributes.description: Comma-separated values to cycle through. An empty entry means "no class".

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Selector for the element(s) whose class is set. Default `html`.

attributes.name: storage-key
attributes.description: localStorage key to persist under. Without it, the value isn't persisted.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current value. Reflects; set it to choose the initial value when nothing is stored.

declarations.summary: A persisted class switch (e.g. a theme toggle) driven by buttons.

declarations.description:
Registers a markup-only custom element whose content comes from a
`<template>` child (or a `content` attribute).
declarations.name: DefineComponentByContent

events.name: load
events.description: The element is registered (or the name already was).

attributes.description: The tag name to register.
attributes.name: name

attributes.description: The markup, if there's no `<template>` child.
attributes.name: content

attributes.description: `open` (default) or `closed` shadow root, or `none` to append the markup as light DOM.
attributes.name: mode

declarations.summary: Register a markup-only custom element from inline HTML.

declarations.description:
Imports a module and registers its export as a custom element. Fires
`load`/`error` like `<script src>`.
declarations.name: DefineComponent

members.name: ready
members.description:
Resolves with the registered class once the element is defined; rejects
if it couldn't be.

events.name: load
events.description: The element is registered (or the name already was).
The module failed to load, lacked the export, or the export isn't a class. An `ErrorEvent`.
events.name: error

attributes.description: The tag name to register.
attributes.name: name

attributes.description: URL of the module, resolved against the document's base URL.
attributes.name: src

attributes.description: Name of the export to register. Default `default`.
attributes.name: import

declarations.summary: Register a custom element from a module URL, in HTML.

declarations.description:
Imports a module and assigns its export to a global, unless the global
already exists. Fires `load`/`error` like `<script src>`.
declarations.name: PolyfillWindow

members.name: ready
members.description: Resolves with the global's value once it's in place.

events.name: error
events.description: The module failed to load or lacked the export. An `ErrorEvent`.

events.name: load
events.description: The global is in place (assigned now, or already there).

attributes.description: The global to assign (`window[name]`).
attributes.name: name

attributes.description: URL of the module, resolved against the document's base URL.
attributes.name: src

attributes.description: Name of the export to assign. Default `default`.
attributes.name: import

declarations.summary: Load a module's export onto window, in HTML.

declarations.description:
A menu whose items drill into screens (each item's `<template>`), with
roving keyboard focus, Back via Esc/`data-back`/commands, focus
restoration, and optional `location.hash` sync.
declarations.name: DrillMenu

members.name: items
members.description: The items: element children other than templates and the screen.

members.name: screen
members.description: Key of the open screen, or null. Setting it navigates.

members.name: push
members.description:
Show the screen of the item with this key (its `data-key`, or its
position). Items without a template are leaves and can't be pushed.

members.name: pop
members.description: Return to the list, restoring focus to the item that opened the screen.

events.name: push
events.description: A screen was shown. `event.detail` is `{ key, item }`.

events.name: pop
events.description: The menu returned to the list. `event.detail` is `{ key, item }` for the screen that closed.

attributes.name: screen
attributes.description: Key of the screen currently shown (absent = the list). Reflects; set it to navigate.
Mirror the current screen in `location.hash`, so links and the browser's Back button work.
attributes.name: sync-hash

declarations.summary: A list that drills into sub-screens and back.

declarations.description:
Opens and closes the `<dialog>` inside it with a keyboard shortcut,
keeping the dialog fully native. Polyfills `closedby="any"`/`"none"`.
declarations.name: HotkeyDialog

members.name: dialog
members.description: The `<dialog>` this element controls: its first `<dialog>` descendant.

members.name: show
members.description: Open the dialog (modally, unless `non-modal`).

members.name: close
members.description: Close the dialog.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Open the dialog if it's closed, close it if it's open.

attributes.name: hotkey
attributes.description: One or more space-separated shortcuts, e.g. `mod+k /`. `mod` is ⌘ on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere.
Open with `show()` instead of `showModal()`.
attributes.name: non-modal

declarations.summary: Toggle a native dialog with a keyboard shortcut.

type.text: (this: object, opts: { finalizer: (fn: Function) => void, dehydrator: (fn: Function) => void }) => Promise<void>

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Method name for the hydrate operation.

parameters.name: dehydrateName
parameters.description: Method name for its counterpart. Defaults to `de${name}`.

declarations.description:
Applies classes, inline styles, and attributes to its direct children
while media queries match, restoring what was there when they stop.
declarations.name: AttributeProvider

attributes.name: classes
attributes.description: `[media query] class class | …` sections. Bracket-less sections always apply.

attributes.name: styles
attributes.description: `[media query] property: value; … | …` sections.

attributes.name: attributes
attributes.description: `[media query] name=value; name; name=null | …` sections. `null` removes the attribute while the query matches.

declarations.summary: Add classes, styles, and attributes to children by media query.

declarations.description:
Wraps its children in a different element depending on media queries:
the same items in a `<ul>` on small screens and an `<ol>` on large ones.
declarations.name: QueryContainer

attributes.name: default
attributes.description: Wrapper when no query matches, as a simple selector (`ul`, `ol.steps`, `div#x[data-y=z]`). Defaults to the first section's.

attributes.name: query
attributes.description: `[media query] selector` sections separated by `|`. The last matching section wins.

declarations.summary: Swap the element wrapping some content by media query.

declarations.description:
A listbox whose options are ordinary, fully stylable elements, with the
same API, form behavior, and events as a native `<select>` listbox.
declarations.name: StylableSelect

members.name: options
members.description: Every option, in document order (including those in groups).

members.name: selectedOptions
members.description: The selected options.

members.name: selectedIndex
members.description:
Index of the first selected option, or -1. Setting it selects only that
option. Script changes don't fire events.

members.name: value
members.description:
Value of the first selected option, or "". Setting it selects the first
option with that value (or nothing, if none matches).

members.name: length
members.description: Number of options.

members.name: type
members.description: "select-one" or "select-multiple", like a native select.

members.name: item
members.description: The option at `index`.

members.name: form
members.description: The form this element belongs to.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this element.

events.name: change
events.description: The user changed the selection (fired right after `input`, like a native select).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction and form submission. Also inherited from a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid until an option is selected.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Allow selecting more than one option.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Number of visible rows (sets `--domkit-select-size`, used by index.css).
Name submitted with the form.
attributes.name: name

declarations.summary: A fully stylable listbox that works like a native select.

declarations.description:
Tabs and panels from plain children, following the WAI-ARIA tabs
pattern: roles, ids, roving tabindex, and keyboard support are wired
onto whatever markup you write.
declarations.name: TabbedUI

cssProperties.description: Color of the selected-tab indicator and focus ring (index.css).
cssProperties.name: --domkit-tab-accent

cssProperties.description: Color of the line under the tab list (index.css).
cssProperties.name: --domkit-tab-border

members.name: tabList
members.description: The tab list: the child with role="tablist", else the first element child.

members.name: tabs
members.description: The tabs, in order.

members.name: panels
members.description: The panels, in order (every element child except the tab list).

members.name: selectedIndex
members.description: Index of the selected tab. Setting it does not fire `change`.

members.name: manual
members.description: With `manual`, arrow keys move focus and Enter/Space selects.

events.name: change
events.description: The user selected a different tab (click or keyboard). Not fired for script changes.

attributes.name: selected-index
attributes.description: Index of the selected tab. Reflects the current selection.

attributes.name: manual
attributes.description: Arrow keys move focus only; Enter/Space selects (manual activation).

declarations.summary: Accessible tabs and panels from plain children.
